title: NCCL Issues Circular on Annual Return Submission for FY 2025-26
content:
# NCCL Issues Circular on Annual Return Submission for FY 2025-26

Ek important update hai. National Commodity Clearing Limited (NCCL) ne Financial Year 2025-26 ke Annual Return submission ke liye ek naya circular announce kiya hai.

Yeh circular October 15, 2026, ko jaari kiya gaya hai. Iska objective sabhi concerned members aur participants ko FY 2025-26 ke Annual Return submit karne ki procedure aur timeline ke baare mein inform karna hai.

**Key Highlights of the Circular:**

*   **Circular Reference:** Circular No. NCCL/COMPLIANCE/AR/2026-27/01 dated October 15, 2026.
*   **Mandatory Submission:** All members and participants are required to submit their Annual Return for the Financial Year 2025-26.
*   **Compliance:** Circular emphasizes the strict adherence to the prescribed format and due dates for filing to ensure regulatory compliance.
*   **Purpose:** This circular serves as a timely reminder to ensure smooth and timely submission of the mandatory annual filings.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.nccl.co.in/)

*Published on: 16 October 2026*
